import NonCalkinAlgebra.TwistedRegularStar
import NonCalkinAlgebra.AFCoefficientStatements

noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NonCalkinAlgebra.TwistedRegular
open BinaryPhase
universe u
variable {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G]

/-- The unital algebraic *-algebra generated by the actual signed shifts. -/
def polynomialSubalgebra (c : Cocycle G) :
    StarSubalgebra ℂ (SquareSummable G →L[ℂ] SquareSummable G) :=
  StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (shift c))

/-- The operator-norm closed *-algebra. Its norm, multiplication and adjoint
are inherited from the actual Hilbert-space operators. -/
def closedSubalgebra (c : Cocycle G) :
    StarSubalgebra ℂ (SquareSummable G →L[ℂ] SquareSummable G) :=
  (polynomialSubalgebra c).topologicalClosure

instance closedSubalgebra_isClosed (c : Cocycle G) :
    IsClosed (closedSubalgebra c : Set (SquareSummable G →L[ℂ] SquareSummable G)) :=
  (polynomialSubalgebra c).isClosed_topologicalClosure

theorem shift_mem_closedSubalgebra (c : Cocycle G) (g : G) :
    shift c g ∈ closedSubalgebra c := by
  apply (polynomialSubalgebra c).le_topologicalClosure
  exact StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ (Set.range (shift c)) ⟨g, rfl⟩

def shiftInAlgebra (c : Cocycle G) (g : G) : closedSubalgebra c :=
  ⟨shift c g, shift_mem_closedSubalgebra c g⟩

@[simp] theorem coe_shiftInAlgebra (c : Cocycle G) (g : G) :
    (shiftInAlgebra c g : SquareSummable G →L[ℂ] SquareSummable G) = shift c g := rfl

@[simp] theorem shiftInAlgebra_zero (c : Cocycle G) : shiftInAlgebra c 0 = 1 :=
  Subtype.ext (shift_zero c)

theorem shiftInAlgebra_mul (c : Cocycle G) (g k : G) :
    shiftInAlgebra c g * shiftInAlgebra c k =
      phase (c g k) • shiftInAlgebra c (g + k) := Subtype.ext (shift_mul c g k)

theorem star_shiftInAlgebra (c : Cocycle G) (g : G) :
    star (shiftInAlgebra c g) = phase (c g (-g)) • shiftInAlgebra c (-g) :=
  Subtype.ext (star_shift c g)

@[simp] theorem norm_shiftInAlgebra (c : Cocycle G) (g : G) : ‖shiftInAlgebra c g‖ = 1 :=
  norm_shift c g

/-- A concrete nonzero unital complex C*-algebra for each binary cocycle.
AF, simplicity, density and distinction require separate proofs. -/
def banachAlgebra (c : Cocycle G) : ComplexCStarAlgebra.{u} where
  Carrier := closedSubalgebra c
  normedRing := inferInstance
  normedAlgebra := inferInstance
  completeSpace := inferInstance
  nontrivial := inferInstance
  starRing := inferInstance
  cstarRing := inferInstance
  starModule := inferInstance

end NonCalkinAlgebra.TwistedRegular
